title: Among female patients diagnosed with SLE who have a normal Rhuematoid Facto
question: Among female patients diagnosed with SLE who have a normal Rhuematoid Factor (RA = '-' or '+-'), what percentage have at least one laboratory test showing abnormal total protein levels (TP ≤ 6.0 or TP ≥ 8.5)?

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN L."XCL_020" <= 6.0 OR L."XCL_020" >= 8.5 THEN P."XCL_058" END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
  COUNT(DISTINCT P."XCL_058") AS percentage
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND P."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND P."XCL_063" IN ('-', '+-')
